overview_description.description: Sagecare operates a private, nurse-led dementia care home that focuses on residents experiencing dementia and changing cognitive abilities. The organization runs a small-scale elder living community with cognitive supports, providing residential dementia care, Alzheimer’s care, and memory care living. Services include 24/7 nursing and personal support, incontinence care, transfer assistance, daily routines, and structured activities such as recreation, art, music, and therapeutic programs. Sagecare develops individualized care plans, offers geriatric and psychogeriatric consultation, and supports palliative and end-of-life care within the home. The team works closely with families through communication, shared decision-making, and support during transitions from home care or assisted living into memory care. Its environment is organized into small households and designed to facilitate safety, orientation, and social connection for elders.
